facilities.description:
LUFX GAYA STREET PICKLEBALL COURT POLICY
Effective: July 1, 2025
Welcome to the LUFX Gaya Street Pickleball Court! To ensure a safe and enjoyable experience for everyone, please adhere to the following policies.

*Booking Policy*
IMPORTANT – Membership Requirement
👉 Anyone booking and using the Pickleball Court *must first be a Level Up Fitness Xpress / Premium member.

1. General Court & Booking Rules
Valid Booking Required: 
Using the court without a valid booking is not permitted. Our team will provide gentle reminders to anyone on the court without a reservation.


Booking Platform: 


Final Sale Policy: 
To ensure fair booking opportunities, all bookings are final. No refunds or rescheduling will be allowed for any reason. Please double-check your desired date and time before confirming your payment.


Court Area: 
The court area is to be used primarily for pickleball games. Please keep the surrounding area clear of personal items and obstructions.


Automated Lighting: 
The court lighting is synced to your booking time. The lights will turn on at the start of your session and automatically turn off when your time has ended.

2. Non-Member Walk-In Policy
Non-Level Up Fitness members are welcome to play but must adhere to the following walk-in rules:
Staffed Hours Only: 
Access for non-members is strictly limited to our staffed hours. You must depart the premises before these hours end.
Monday - Friday	: 11:30 AM - 8:00 PM
Saturday & Sunday	: 1:00 PM - 5:30 PM
Public Holidays	: Unstaffed (No non-member access)
Registration & Fees: 
Upon arrival, all non-members must:
Register at the Front Desk by presenting a valid Malaysian IC or Passport.
Pay the RM35 walk-in fee per person. This includes access to the Level 3 gym and facilities during staffed hours.
Pay a RM20 refundable deposit for a temporary gym access card. The deposit will be returned when the card is returned in good condition.

3. Safety, Liability & Responsibility
Use at Own Risk:
All members and guests acknowledge that using gym facilities and participating in physical activities like pickleball carry inherent risks. By entering the premises, you voluntarily assume all risks of personal injury or accident and agree to use all facilities at your own risk.


Personal Property: 
You are solely responsible for your personal belongings. Due to the court's rooftop location, this includes responsibility for any pickleballs that may leave the court area. Level Up Fitness is not liable for any lost, stolen, or damaged property.


Damage to Facility: 
Any damage caused to the gym facility, court, or rented equipment due to user negligence or misuse will be the financial responsibility of the user, who will be charged for the full cost of repair or replacement.

4. Want More Access? Become a Member!
Tired of walk-in restrictions? Enjoy unlimited gym access and priority court bookings by signing up as a Level Up Fitness member! We also offer 7-day, 30-day, or 90-day short-term passes.
Sign up online at members.levelupfitness.com or visit our Front Desk during staffed hours.

Management Rights: 
The management of Level Up Fitness reserves the right to amend these policies at any time. We also reserve the right to refuse entry or revoke access for anyone found repeatedly violating gym rules, causing a disturbance, or engaging in unsafe conduct

	•	Players must wear non-marking indoor sports shoes.

	•	No food, chewing gum, or smoking inside the court area.

	•	Do not enter the court before your scheduled time and vacate promptly after your session ends.

3. Safety & Liability
	•	Play at your own risk. The facility is not liable for injuries, lost items, or damage to personal belongings.

4. Facility Care

Failure to comply with these policies may result in suspension or banning from future bookings. Thank you for your cooperation!

policies.privacy_policy:
Booking Central privacy

Browsing this directory does not require an account. Booking requests are handled by the Booking Central booking service, where you sign in to view and manage your requests.

The booking service stores your account identifier, name, email address, phone number, requested session, notes and booking status. These records are available to your signed-in account and the Booking Central administrator.

Customer booking records are stored separately from this public website. Read the booking service privacy information before submitting a request.

Venue details are directory listings. Contact the venue to confirm current information.
policies.terms_condition:
Booking Central terms of use

You may browse venues and submit booking requests through the Booking Central booking service. A request starts as pending approval. It does not reserve a court until an administrator has checked availability with the venue and confirmed it.

Check My Bookings for your status, assigned court and administrator notes. Requests can be cancelled from your account. Payment is arranged with the venue; this service does not collect online payments.

Listed rates and operating hours may change. Confirm current prices and applicable policies with the venue. Automatic email notifications are not currently enabled.
